name: Bulenox
legal_entity_and_hq: Bulenox LLC, 1201 N Orange St, Ste 7149, Wilmington, DE 19801, USA (Delaware governing law)
instruments: 41 CME Group futures (CME, CBOT, NYMEX, COMEX): equity indices, energies, metals, FX, grains, livestock, Micro Bitcoin and Micro Ether; micros available (1 standard = 10 micros). Commissions are charged and count toward drawdown and daily loss limit (e.g. ES $4.18 round turn, MES/MNQ $1.22 round turn).

programs.name: Qualification (end-of-day option)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing (option 2), with a scaling plan
programs.notes: Access valid for 30 days. A trailing (intraday) option is sold at the same sizes; the choice is locked for the life of the account. Passing leads to a Master account, which Bulenox charges an activation fee for; the amount is not shown on the pricing page.

news_trading: Allowed (homepage: CPI, FOMC, NFP, no blackout windows)
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: Terms of Use prohibit scalping algorithms, the DTC Protocol Bridge API, automated discretionary trading and very large numbers of rapid trades; third-party algorithms need Bulenox management approval
copy_trading: Restricted: trade copiers/third-party software connected via Rithmic API carry a $100 monthly fee; Bulenox does not support them. Policy on copying between people not published in readable form.
overnight_weekend_holding: Not allowed: positions must be closed by 3:59 PM CT; holding overnight is 'strictly prohibited'.
restricted_countries_note: Bulenox does not publish its country list in a readable form; check with Bulenox before buying.
path_to_live: After 3 successful payouts on active Master accounts, accounts may be considered for a Funded (live capital) account; not automatic, at Bulenox's discretion, requires signing the Funded Account Agreement.

current_public_promo.applies_to: Qualification, Fast Track and Momentum accounts; Bulenox says the code never expires

affiliate_program.notes: Affiliate signup page linked in the site footer; commission terms not readable (page blocks automated fetching).

recent_changes_2026.change: Profit split changed to 100% of first $10,000 then 90%; payout frequency changed to weekly on Wednesdays; drawdown changed from balance-based to trailing with EOD option (reported by a third-party tracker)

Fast Track and Momentum launched; Qualification switched from monthly subscription to one-time 30-day access; 250K size removed; max active Master accounts cut from 11 to 5 (reported by a third-party tracker)

best_for: Futures traders on Rithmic-based platforms who want a low one-time evaluation fee and want to trade news.
